verdict.rationale: v0's own docs describe one-click deployment to production on Vercel infrastructure, with a shared production URL per Project. A community user independently reports a fast dev-to-deploy cycle that put a working MVP in users' hands. missing for 10: an explicit description of the live URL format or domain assignment at publish time, and a detailed hands-on walkthrough of the one-click publish flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Deploy with one click to secure, scalable infrastructure powered by Vercel.
Go live instantly with one-click deployment to production in seconds.
When multiple chats share a Project, deploying from any of them updates the same production URL.
The speed was incredible, not just code generation, but the entire dev-to-deploy cycle.
